entries.en: We might be able to gain intel from[n]talking to them. Just don't ask any[n]suspicious questions, okay?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: There are a lot of people around here...[n]Wouldn't somebody have to know about[n]the [clr 2]membership card[clr 27]?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm not sure, but either way, it seems[n]asking around is our only option.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That was actually pretty easy. Should it[n]have been that simple?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who cares? It's all thanks to that dick[n]Shido thinkin' everyone around him[n]is incompetent.

entries.speaker: Haru

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, it's not bad that it went by quick.[n]Let's head to the [clr 2]restaurant[clr 27] and grab a[n]letter of introduction.
